_comment_top: Example Claude Code settings wiring JS/TS hooks, dedicated .NET hooks, and generic safety rails. Copy to ~/.claude/settings.json and adjust hook paths if you installed the hooks somewhere other than ~/.claude/hooks/.

permissions._comment: bypassPermissions = Claude Code will not prompt for each tool call. Use 'prompt' if you prefer to approve each tool call individually. The hooks below provide the safety net when permissions are bypassed.

hooks.command: input=$(cat | jq -r '.input // empty'); if echo "$input" | grep -qE 'rm\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*r[a-zA-Z]*f|--recursive.*--force|-rf)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: rm -rf is dangerous' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Block rm -rf

hooks.command: input=$(cat | jq -r '.input // empty'); if echo "$input" | grep -qE 'git\s+push.*(-f|--force).*\s+(main|master)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Force pushing to main/master is not allowed.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Block force push to main/master

hooks.command: node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const i=JSON.parse(d);const cmd=i.tool_input?.command||'';if(/--no-verify/.test(cmd)){process.stderr.write('[Hook] BLOCKED: --no-verify is not allowed. Let git hooks run.\n');process.exit(2)}process.stdout.write(d)})"
hooks.description: Block --no-verify flag (git hooks must run)
Block direct commits / force pushes on main / master / production
Pre-commit: block debugger statements and secrets in staged files
Pre-commit: block .NET debug breakpoints and secrets in staged files

hooks.command: filepath=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // .file_path // .filePath // empty'); if echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.(env|pem|key|pfx|p12|snk)$|/secrets/|credentials|secrets\.json|appsettings\.(Production|Staging|Prod)\.json|\.pubxml(\.user)?$|\.csproj\.user$'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot modify sensitive file: $filepath" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
hooks.description: Block writes to secret-bearing env, credential, certificate, publish, and production config files
Block modifications to linter/formatter config files
Block casual modifications to .NET build/analyzer/package config files
Suggest /compact every ~50 tool calls
Check MCP server health before tool execution
Warn at 500KB, block at 2MB to protect context
Record errors to ~/.claude/error-log.md
Audit log all bash commands with auto-redaction
Accumulate edited JS/TS files for batch format at Stop
Accumulate edited .NET files for quality checks at Stop
Warn on generic template-looking frontend UI
Run sibling test files and report failures
Run related .NET test projects and report failures
Track MCP server failures with exponential backoff
Batch format (Prettier) + typecheck (tsc) all edited JS/TS files
Run .NET format verification and build for edited .NET files
Check for stray console.log in modified files
Check for C# debug/log leftovers in modified files
Track token usage and estimated cost per response
Append session summary to ~/.claude/sessions/ for later search

hooks.command: echo '[Hooks] Session started — active: commit-quality, config-protection, suggest-compact, MCP health, audit-log, design-quality, batch-format, cost-tracker, error-log, test-runner, branch-protection, large-file-warner, session-summary' >&2; exit 0
